title: cyclosorus clarkei
intro: Cyclosorus clarkei, commonly known as Clarke's fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a medicinal plant that has been traditionally used in various cultures to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cyclosorus clarkei include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain, prevent infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic effects.
